overall_notes: This paper is primarily a human-centered qualitative study exploring user experience with different human-AI interaction patterns in text generation tasks. It does not involve quantitative evaluation of NLG outputs via automatic metrics or LLM judges. The human evaluation is qualitative, focusing on user perceptions and needs rather than scoring generated text quality.
